title: Kissed Smoky American Chicken Skillet
description: A smoky and velvety light American dish featuring chicken, baking powder, and a stone bowl dolsot, low in fat and calories.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, baking powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large stone bowl dolsot or oven safe skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coated chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
